caption:
Today's Sky is Yang Fire, The Sun ☀️ Pause on your Day Master.

Your Day Master is the element of the day you were born. Today the sun meets it and creates one of 10 forces: Yang Fire gets a friend day, Yin Earth feels supported, Yang Metal feels the heat.

Don't know yours? Find it free at the link in bio.

Which one are you today? Comment below.

#skyandseason #innerconstellation #horoscope #selfdiscovery #knowyourself #fengshui #fourpillars #chineseastrology #astrologyreels #singapore
day_line: The sun on a Rat day. Bright and quick: good for showing up and pitching, easy to overpromise.

lines.Yang Wood: You're the fun one today. Crack the joke, then actually send the deck.
lines.Yin Wood: You'll have opinions about the lunch spot today. Share one, not all twelve.
lines.Yang Fire: Same energy as you everywhere today. Team up on one thing; don't fight for the mic.
lines.Yin Fire: Someone louder grabs the spotlight today. Let them; your work speaks later.
lines.Yang Earth: Reading or a podcast sticks today. Learn one thing on the MRT ride home.
lines.Yin Earth: Someone older offers advice today. Listen first; you can still do it your way.
lines.Yang Metal: The heat is on today. One task at a time, and drink your water.
lines.Yin Metal: Good day to ask for that sign-off. Clear message, polite tone, done.
lines.Yang Water: A lucky break could pop up today: a lead, a deal, a free upgrade. Check before you jump.
lines.Yin Water: Small savings add up today. Bring your own kopi and feel smug about it.
